boundaries.name: public-state-field-and-equality
boundaries.obligation: Uses shared current 15-word PublicState; derive actual field equality/AND/NOT gates and native raw-u64/target representation agreement.

boundaries.name: merkle-path-and-history-binding
boundaries.obligation: The 63-step Merkle hash/path gadget executes even for equal states; its index-range and field/hash lowering remain unproved. A correct local opening does not establish canonical L1 history, finalized roots, strict block increase or timestamp monotonicity.

boundaries.name: native-witness-and-compiler-refinement
boundaries.obligation: Dependency panics, fixed sibling witness-length assertions, formatting/serde and emitted circuit/witness execution must be related to the model; the normal-return correspondence is not whole-program liveness or compiler equivalence.
